architecture_summary: Modular React app. Pages in src/pages/. Shared UI in src/components/. CSS modules for scoped styles. React Router v6 for navigation. No state manager (useContext + useReducer for global state). Prefer native HTML/CSS over libs. Minimal dependencies: react, react-dom, react-router-dom. Build tool: Vite. Testing: Vitest + React Testing Library. Lint: ESLint + Prettier. Type safety: JSDoc + TypeScript in CI check only (no .ts files).

tickets.title: Create base project structure and tooling
tickets.description: Initialize Vite React project. Configure ESLint, Prettier, Vitest. Set up folder structure: src/{pages,components,assets,utils,contexts,hooks}. Add minimal CSS reset. Add React Router v6. Configure base URL for assets. Add .nvmrc for Node 20. Add scripts: dev, build, test, lint, format.
acceptance_criteria: ESLint and Prettier run without errors
React Router v6 installed and configured

tickets.title: Build shared UI components from showcase screens
tickets.description: Extract reusable components from showcase screens. Build: Button, Badge, SelectInput, Toast, Loader. Use CSS modules for styles. Props: minimal, only what changes. Variants via props, not separate components. Accessibility: keyboard nav, ARIA labels, focus states. No external libs. Toast: use context for state. Loader: SVG spinner from design. Button: support icon + text. Badge: color variants via prop.

tickets.title: Build Services Pricing page
tickets.description: Convert Stitch screen to React page. Use shared components: Button, Badge, SelectInput. Layout: CSS Grid for pricing cards. Responsive: mobile-first, 1-column to 3-column. Data: hardcoded array for services. Pricing logic: client-side only. No API calls. Add hover/focus states for cards. Accessibility: semantic HTML, keyboard nav. Error state: none (static page).

tickets.title: Build Data Table component and showcase page
tickets.description: Build reusable DataTable component. Features: sorting (client-side), pagination (client-side), row selection (optional). Props: data, columns, pagination, sorting. Styling: CSS modules. No external libs. Showcase page: demo with sample data. Table: fixed header, scrollable body. Accessibility: keyboard nav, ARIA labels. Responsive: horizontal scroll on small screens.

tickets.title: Build 404 page (brutalist design)
tickets.description: Convert Stitch 404 screen to React page. Brutalist design: no shared components. Raw HTML/CSS. Animation: CSS keyframes for glitch effect. Responsive: full viewport. Accessibility: focusable link, ARIA labels. No JavaScript for animation. Link: back to home. Error: 404 status code (via React Router).

tickets.title: Build Pricing System page (main dashboard)
tickets.description: Convert main Stitch screen to React page. Layout: complex grid. Components: DataTable (from TASK-004), Button, Badge, SelectInput, Toast. Data: hardcoded. Features: filter by service, sort by price, pagination. State: local component state. No API calls. Accessibility: keyboard nav, ARIA labels. Responsive: mobile-first, 1-column to multi-column. Error state: none (static data).

tickets.title: App shell, navigation bar, and router wiring (src/App.jsx)
tickets.description: Create app shell. Navigation: header with logo + nav links. Router: React Router v6. Routes: / (PricingSystem), /services (ServicesPricing), /table (TableShowcase), /404 (NotFound). Layout: shared header/footer. Toast: global provider. Error boundary: none (static app). 404: catch-all route. Responsive: mobile menu (CSS-only, no JS). Accessibility: skip link, ARIA labels. No external libs.
